title: FedEx Earns Top Honors at the 2026 Supply Chain Asia Awards For Logistics Innovation and Customer Excellence

**SINGAPORE, November 10, 2026** — Federal Express Corporation (FedEx), one of the world’s largest express transportation companies, has received two prestigious awards at the **2026 Supply Chain Asia Awards** , highlighting its leadership in supply chain innovation, industry-leading logistics solutions and customer experience across Asia Pacific.


FedEx was recognized with the following awards:


- **Last Mile Partner of the Year**
- **Supply Chain Woman of the Year** awarded to Angie Hong, Vice President, Sales & Solutions, Asia Pacific


Presented by[Supply Chain Asia](https://supplychainasia.org/awards2026/)


, **** the awards recognize organizations and individuals that are shaping the future of supply chains across the region through innovation, operational excellence, and customer-centric logistics solutions. The recognition underscores FedEx’s commitment to enabling resilient supply chains, digital transformation, and cross-border trade through enhanced connectivity, visibility, and technology-enabled end-to-end supply chain solutions.


The *Last Mile Partner of the Year* award recognizes the efforts of FedEx to transform the customer experience through solutions that improve visibility, convenience, and reliability. Innovations such as real-time shipment tracking, flexible delivery options, digital engagement channels, and investments in automation and AI-enabled operations help businesses meet evolving customer expectations, while supporting growth in e-commerce markets, AI and data center infrastructure, healthcare, life sciences, and other time-sensitive industries.


The *Supply Chain Woman of the Year* award recognizes Angie Hong, Vice President, Sales & Solutions, Asia Pacific, FedEx, for her outstanding leadership in advancing customer-focused supply chain solutions and driving commercial growth across the region. Through stronger customer engagement, expansion into strategic industry verticals, and the adoption of digital and data-driven solutions, Hong has strengthened FedEx ability to support businesses navigate uncertainty, while delivering new growth opportunities.


“These awards are a tremendous honor and reflect the trust our customers place in us every day, as well as the dedication of our team members across Asia Pacific,” said Salil Chari, president, Asia Pacific, FedEx. “From enhancing the end-to-end logistics experience through greater visibility and control, to helping customers build more resilient and agile supply chains, we remain focused on delivering solutions that enable growth. We are also especially proud to see our leaders recognized for creating lasting value for our customers and advancing supply chain excellence for the industry.”
